query.text: 请看着我切菜，有不卫生或不规范的操作时请及时纠正我。
query.text_en: Please watch me cut ingredients and promptly correct any unhygienic or improper actions.

annotation.text_zh: 刀上有生肉血迹，请清洗后再切苹果。
annotation.text_en: There's raw meat blood on the knife, please wash it before cutting the apple.
